message: 努力の跡

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, let's give it our all in today's Student Council activities too!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm going to enjoy my youth through studying, the Student Council, and the Crusaders. Aim for a sparkling school life!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... If Master Synn's powers awaken, you could live a blood-drenched, glaring youth instead, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't want something that sounds so bloody!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, everyone--」

name: Misa
message: 「Mmmm... Smells so good」
Misa is alone in the Student Council room.
Her motives are unknown, but she has a textbook pressed right against her face, sniffing it in utter ecstasy.

name: Misa
message: 「Gasp!? S-S-S-Sakura-kun! N-No, you've got it wrong, um... th-this is!!」
...Let's pretend I didn't see that.

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, time to drop by the Student Council today too!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm going to enjoy my youth as a scholarship student, as president, and as a member of the Crusaders. Aim for a sparkling school life!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... If Master Synn puts his mind to it, you could live a greasy, glistening youth instead, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「No thanks to something that sounds so oily!」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Misa!? I went through the trouble of redoing my entrance, so why are you standing right in front of the door?!」

name: Misa
message: 「Shut up!! I was lying in wait for you!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, you've got a bump...」

name: Misa
message: 「It doesn't hurt!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Seriously? Even though the door slammed right into you?」

name: Misa
message: 「I don't feel a thing!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I see... Well then, let's start over one more time」

name: Misa
message: 「The fact that you're insisting on a do-over means... Sakura-kun, you saw, didn't you!?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I-I-I didn't see anything, I didn't! I didn't see a thing!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, right! Lord Synn definitely didn't witness Hisu sniffing her textbook and grinning like a creep, got it?」

name: Misa
message: 「Nooooo, so you DID see me after all!」

name: Misa
message: 「Kieee! If it's come to this...」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, why are you locking the door?」

name: Misa
message: 「So you can't escape, Sakura-kun. Now we're all alone in a locked room.」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek...! W-What are you planning to do to me!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Nothing... As long as you keep my secret, I'll guarantee your safety.」

name: Misa
message: 「However, if you tell anyone about what just happened... *glare*!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You don't have to be so embarrassed about it. I smell my textbooks and study guides too, you know?」

name: Misa
message: 「No way!!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's true, though only the really well-used ones.」

name: Synn
message: 「Once you've written in lots of notes and underlined things yourself, the scents of highlighter and ballpoint pen ink mix together to create a really nice aroma.」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, just like a refreshing breeze blowing through a lush green forest right after the rain...」

name: Synn
message: 「For some reason, you can't recreate that smell just by writing on any random piece of paper.」

name: Misa
message: 「It's mysterious, isn't it? I tried that too, and it didn't work.」

name: Synn
message: 「Logically speaking, I think every time you flip through a study guide, the pages are exposed to air and oxidize. That brings them closer to the original scent of wood.」

name: Misa
message: 「And when hundreds of pages like that are layered together, it surely turns into the scent of a forest.」
I glance over at Misa's textbook resting on the desk.
The cover is closed, yet that alone is enough. It clearly shows just how hard Misa studies.
By observing the fore-edge of a book, you can tell how thoroughly its owner has read through it.

Pages that have been read carefully change color from white to a warm, skin-like beige. You wouldn't notice it looking at a single sheet, but once an entire book is well-worn, the difference in color becomes unmistakable.
Two-thirds of the pages in Misa's textbook are that warm beige, while the remaining section they haven't covered in class yet is still white.
...I see. Misa's top grades aren't from coasting on natural talent--they're the result of steady, continuous effort. I need to follow her example!

name: Synn
message: 「Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What's your deal... Even if you compliment me... I-I'm not happy about it or anything」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, because I hate you, you know!」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Did I say that out loud by any chance?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hawawawa, the door is locked, you know. We can't get into the Student Council room like this.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yay♪ It opened!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Aw man, that butler guy went and sniped the lock right off」

name: Misa
message: 「Nngh... Could it be that Riesling-san saw me too?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, it's an arrow-letter from Jeeves.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm, let's see... It says, 'I did not see anything, Lady Misa.' What could that mean?」

name: Misa
message: 「N-Noooooooo!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hello, Madam President, Mr. Vice President! Let's have fun with Student Council today too.」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah... ahh... ahh... ah... ahh...」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Misa...」
